habits.boundary_condition: Apply this to the return flight's departure time, not necessarily its arrival time; a stricter after-6:00-p.m. preference should only be applied when explicitly stated for the trip.
habits.condition: When choosing the return leg of a round-trip flight.
habits.default_action: Search and present return departures in the afternoon or evening first.
habits.exception_condition: No reusable fallback or exception is established by this evidence; relax the timing only after checking with the traveler if later return options are unavailable.
habits.name: return_departure_afternoon_or_later
habits.preference_value: Return flights tend to be preferred in the afternoon or evening rather than the morning.
habits.rationale: All three independent dialogues place the return flight in the afternoon or evening, while only one supports a consistent after-6:00-p.m. threshold. The reusable default is therefore afternoon-or-later, expressed softly.

source_evidence.contribution: Clarifies that the return-leg departure, rather than arrival, should be in the evening after 6:00 p.m.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: No, I want to leave SFO after 6:00 p.m. and arrive back at LaGuardia or any airport in New York whenever, the earliest I can guess from leaving 6:00 p.m. SFO.

source_evidence.contribution: Independently supports an afternoon return-flight preference.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: I'm looking to get a flight in the morning from 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM and the one that comes back that it could be in the afternoon.

source_evidence.contribution: Directly states an afternoon-or-evening preference for the return flight.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: I'd prefer a afternoon or evening flight.
